2607.16934.title: Optimizing Clinical Trial Protocols Using EHR-Derived Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
2607.16934.paper_summary: Traditional randomized trials often obscure clinically meaningful heterogeneity in treatment response by focusing on average effects. Leveraging real-world data to emulate clinical trials and estimate heterogeneous treatment effects (HTEs) offers a promising path toward more precise and efficient trial design. In this study, we emulate the DAPA-HF trial using electronic health records from the Mayo Clinic Cloud (MCC) to investigate whether HTE-guided stratification can identify patient subgroups with distinct treatment responses to dapagliflozin versus placebo in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. All-cause mortality was evaluated using Cox proportional hazards models, with HTEs estimated using a Meta-S learner and subgroups defined using a decision tree-based thresholding approach. In the overall cohort of the emulation, no significant treatment difference was observed (HR, 1.681; 95% CI, 0.828-3.413; p = 0.1507). However, compared with the overall emulated cohort, in which dapagliflozin showed no statistically significant survival benefit, HTE-driven stratification identified subgroups with significant and directionally distinct treatment effects. The beneficial (low-HTE) subgroup showed a significant survival benefit from dapagliflozin (HR = 0.203, 95% CI, 0.087-0.476, p = 0.0002), whereas the harmful (high-HTE) subgroup showed a significant harmful association with markedly increased mortality risk (HR = 6.680, 95% CI, 2.759-16.171, p < 0.0001). These findings indicate that HTE-guided stratification can uncover clinically meaningful beneficial and harmful treatment-effect patterns that are masked in the full-cohort emulation.
2607.16934.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的隨機試驗常常因專注於平均效果而掩蓋治療反應中的臨床意義異質性。利用現實世界數據來模擬臨床試驗並估計異質性治療效果（HTEs）為更精確和高效的試驗設計提供了一條有前景的途徑。在本研究中，我們利用梅奧診所雲端（MCC）的電子健康記錄模擬DAPA-HF試驗，以調查HTE指導的分層是否能識別心臟衰竭伴隨減少射血分數的患者中對達格列淨與安慰劑的治療反應有明顯差異的患者亞組。全因死亡率使用Cox比例風險模型進行評估，HTEs則使用Meta-S學習者估計，亞組則使用基於決策樹的閾值方法定義。在模擬的整體隊列中，未觀察到顯著的治療差異（HR，1.681；95% CI，0.828-3.413；p = 0.1507）。然而，與整體模擬隊列相比，在該隊列中達格列淨未顯示出統計上顯著的生存益處，HTE驅動的分層識別出具有顯著且方向性不同的治療效果的亞組。受益（低-HTE）亞組顯示出來自達格列淨的顯著生存益處（HR = 0.203，95% CI，0.087-0.476，p = 0.0002），而有害（高-HTE）亞組則顯示出與顯著增加的死亡風險有顯著的有害關聯（HR = 6.680，95% CI，2.759-16.171，p < 0.0001）。這些發現表明，HTE指導的分層可以揭示在全隊列模擬中被掩蓋的臨床意義上的有益和有害治療效果模式。
